name: Teaching Children
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital responsibility of parents to diligently teach their children God's commands, embedding His words deeply in their hearts and daily lives, as seen in Deuteronomy 6:6-7. Children are recognized as a precious heritage from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), and loving discipline is essential for their proper growth (Proverbs 13:24). By training children in the way they should go, parents ensure that their guidance endures throughout life (Proverbs 22:6), culminating in the promise that all children taught by the Lord will experience great peace (Isaiah 54:13).
